correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs a characteristic-polynomial invariance lemma via formal resolvent for even-degree symmetric binary adjacency matrices, the Rule-90 local-ring primary decomposition, and the explicit kernel/image intersection of the swapped map. A directly implemented standalone checker passed exhaustive all-state enumeration for n=4,6,8,10,12,16 and algebraic rank checks through n=128. Finite testing is corroboration, not the universal proof.

value.rationale: A natural even-dimensional regime left open by the motivating PXCA work is classified exactly. A minimal, physically meaningful rearrangement of two output wires leaves the full characteristic polynomial unchanged but nearly doubles worst-case transient time on dyadic rings. The infinite-family nilpotent classification and full state-count distribution answer natural finite-state dynamical invariants, rather than merely recomputing a single small instance.
